_docs.how_to_change_hero_image: Set `active` to the id of any variant below to switch the hero. Add new variants for festivals or offers (Diwali, New Year, Valentine's Day, etc.) and toggle by changing `active`. When Laravel is wired up, this file's shape will be replaced by GET /api/hero-config returning the exact same structure.
_docs.campaign_field: If a variant has a non-null `campaign`, a small ribbon badge appears on the hero image with the given label + line and (optionally) a CTA link. Leave `campaign` as null for a clean hero.

campaign.label: New Year Offer
campaign.line: Bring in 2026 with our celebration cakes
